```js
function keplerE(M, e) {
  // Solve E - e sinE = M via Newton's method, M in radians [0, 2π]
  let E = M + e * Math.sin(M); // initial guess
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const f = E - e * Math.sin(E) - M;
    const fp = 1 - e * Math.cos(E);
    E -= f / fp;
  }
  return E;
}
function trueAnomaly(E, e) {
  // return ν in [0, 2π)
  const ν = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(1+e) * Math.sin(E/2), Math.sqrt(1-e) * Math.cos(E/2));
  return (ν + 2*Math.PI) % (2*Math.PI);
}
```

```js
const eT  = (MARS.auRadius - EARTH.auRadius) / (MARS.auRadius + EARTH.auRadius);
const wE  = 360 / EARTH.periodDays;   // graus/dia

const returnDays = outboundDays;
const totalDays  = outboundDays + stayDays + returnDays;                  // ≈ 972 d

const t2 = outboundDays + stayDays;

  M = ((M % TWO_PI) + TWO_PI) % TWO_PI;
  let E = M + eT*Math.sin(M);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++){
    const f = E - eT*Math.sin(E) - M;
    const dE = f / (1 - eT*Math.cos(E));
    E -= dE;
    if (Math.abs(dE) < 1e-15) break;
  }
  return E;
}

    const r  = aT * (1 - eT*Math.cos(E));
```
